description: Audit an HTML page against the WCAG 2.1 success criteria that can be decided from the markup alone — page language, title, headings, a missing alt attribute, form-field labels, link and button names, table headers, iframe titles and zoom restrictions that stop a screen reader or low-vision user — each failure named with its criterion and conformance level, plus a per-criterion pass/fail table and an overall verdict. Before shipping a page, to catch the WCAG failures a markup scan can decide deterministically. Do not choose this when you need contrast, keyboard or screen-reader testing, which needs a rendered page and a human. Example requests: Audit this HTML page for WCAG 2.1 accessibility failures. | Which WCAG success criteria does this markup fail? | Check this page for missing alt text, labels and a page language. | Run an accessibility conformance audit over this HTML.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

html.description: The customer's page.html, as text. Supported: HTML. The HTML document to audit. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_accessibility_conformance_audit

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Accessibility conformance audit
